create.name: Suzanne Dion
create.bio:
Suzanne Dion teaches the Enneagram as a path of self-knowledge, with a particular interest in how personality type shapes our closest relationships. She trained as a teacher with the Palmer-Daniels school, now The Narrative Enneagram, gaining certification in 2008, and later added coaching qualifications. Her long friendship and collaboration with the psychiatrist David Daniels led to their co-written book, The Enneagram, Relationships, and Intimacy, which she completed after his death; a French edition followed in 2022.

Her approach joins the nine types with ideas from attachment research and mindful awareness, and she frames the work as an inward, quietly spiritual return to oneself rather than a labelling exercise. She offers two-hour typing interviews and one-to-one coaching for individuals, couples and parents, mostly over Zoom, and designs workshops and multi-week trainings for groups, teams and practitioners. She co-leads two monthly online groups for the Enneagram Collaborative Global, teaches as affiliate faculty for The Narrative Enneagram and for a school of spiritual direction, and helped found The Attuned Parent Project in 2024. Earlier she was a founding board member and teacher of the Enneagram Prison Project, taking the material into Californian jails and prisons.

books.title: The Enneagram, Relationships, and Intimacy: Understanding One Another Leads to Loving Better and Living More Fully
books.author: David Daniels and Suzanne Dion
books.description: A study of how each of the nine Enneagram types loves, defends itself and seeks closeness, written with her mentor David Daniels. It brings in attachment research and mindful awareness to show couples and friends how to understand one another better.

courses.title: Enneagram Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one coaching that uses the Enneagram to look at habits, defences and strengths, with separate strands for individuals, couples, parents and workplace teams. Sessions are usually held on Zoom.

courses.title: Enneagram Self-Discovery Interview
courses.description: A two-hour conversation to help someone find their Enneagram type, looking at the motives behind what they do rather than relying on an online test. Held on Zoom or in person, with follow-up reading.

courses.title: Workshops and Trainings
courses.description: Talks, day workshops and longer trainings she shapes for groups, families and organisations, including an eight-to-twelve-week typing course for coaches and teachers. Topics range from relationships and intimacy to parenting by type and the divine feminine and masculine.

courses.title: Transforming Relationship Dynamics
courses.description: A monthly hour on Zoom, co-led with Tracy Baker-Lawrence for the Enneagram Collaborative Global, on how type and early attachment play out between partners. Free for members of the collaborative.

courses.title: PDP, Wholeness and The Enneagram
courses.description: A monthly online group she co-leads with Jessica Dibb that reads the nine types alongside ideas from interpersonal neurobiology. It meets on Zoom and is not recorded.
